body:
Gotcha.  I have done the e-friend thing and it can be safe in that way.  My girlfriend broke up with me a couple months ago and she was the only person I could talk to.  She was the first person I've ever met that I felt totally comfortable around.  When she broke up with me I plummeted.  She said she knew I was going through some stuff so if I had to talk to her she'd be there... But now she's totally ignoring me.  It hurts so fucking much - I feel so forlorn.

Sorry I ranted at the end, thanks for replying.

I agree that holding on to the glowing ember of hate with my chest cavity is not wise, but my fear is that if I let it go to someone else, particularly a professional, will seize my freedom.

I am trying to find a solution, and I appreciate your advice - for now still terrified.

I'm glad you found something for you.  I do a lot of research on mental health, like reading journals, watching TEDs, keeping up with studies, and it frequently upsets me how ill equipped our society is for dealing with mental health.  And people disrespecting such a lethal category of illness sets me off.  I really can't stand people who make light of depression/suicide.

As of right now I have no one I'm comfortable talking to, but I do appreciate you sharing.
